events.what: Han, Liu and Zhuang prove (effective) termination of general type MMPs in dimension at most five, including the previously open fivefold case with K+Δ or Δ big

judgement.doubts: The record agrees with the derived codes. The bullet asks about all dimensions >3 and all flip sequences; the preprint covers only general-type MMPs in dimensions 4-5, so it is a case, and it is unreviewed, which does not affect a partial tier. The record says the preprint replaces an earlier split including arXiv:2506.20183 (June 2025), so the first written argument may predate 2025-09-01; either date is after the snapshot, so the status is unaffected. The record says the dimension-4 qualitative general-type case may already have been known before this paper; if so, the newly settled case is narrower (mainly dimension 5), but it is still a case. The Pith Review page was not opened and would not count as digestion anyway (F11).
